chapter.li: Verse6 And now not even one percent of what Jesus taught the people can be written in this book. VerseEnd Verse7 But the plates of Nephi contain most of what He taught the people. VerseEnd Verse16 The next day many people assembled. And they both saw and heard the children, including very young children, who opened their mouths and said astonishing things. Verse17 And Jesus’ disciples began from then on to baptize and teach anyone who came to them. Those who were baptized in the name of Jesus were filled with the Holy Ghost. VerseEnd Verse18 Many of them saw and heard unspeakable things that aren’t lawful to be written. VerseEnd Verse19 They taught and ministered to each other; and they had all things common among them, everyone dealing fairly with each other. VerseEnd Verse20 And they did everything just as Jesus had commanded them. VerseEnd Verse21 Those who were baptized in the name of Jesus were called the congregation of Christ. VerseEnd
